overview:
The **Battle of Pasaana** (35 ABY) was a pivotal engagement of the **Cold War**, fought on or above **Pasaana**. Speeder chase through pasaana desert festival canyons as resistance agents flee first order jet troopers amid cheering crowds and spice mines.

Archives record this battle across saga films, animated series, Knights of the Old Republic, Old Sith Empire chronicles, and expanded universe sources — anchoring the Cold War in both cinematic canon and deep galactic history.
history:
Military historians of the New Republic classify the Battle of Pasaana within the broader **Cold War** campaign. Front-line reports describe speeder chase through pasaana desert festival canyons as resistance agents flee first order jet troopers amid cheering crowds and spice mines.

Commanders on both sides leveraged local terrain, orbital support, and Force-sensitive operatives where available. The engagement's outcome shifted regional control and fed into later battles documented across the same war.

For chronology enthusiasts, **35 ABY** places this conflict in the galactic timeline alongside other famous battles of the Cold War.
significance: The Battle of Pasaana illustrates how the Cold War reshaped the galaxy — through combined arms warfare, political betrayal, and the eternal struggle between light and dark. Its legacy persists in memorials, veteran accounts, and holodramas spanning nine saga films and decades of tie-in fiction.
